title: Store the support portal's passwords so a leaked table resists guessing

cases.says: a row verifies the password it was made from and refuses a one-letter change, a case change and the empty password
the same password hashed for two users gives two different hashes, and both verify
a row made under a lower iteration count verifies with a hasher configured for a higher one
the stored hash equals PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256 of the password over the row's salt and count, 256 bits, and the salt is at least 16 bytes

origin.section: A Password Hash Needs a Salt per User and a Slow Function: PBKDF2, Not SHA-256
